page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with a running head at the top, a page number at the top right, and a signature and catchword at the foot. No margin notes.

main_text.head: ORATIO.
main_text.p: Domine Iesu Christe, quum hoc tempore tantopere in Ecclesiam, quam sanguine tuo redemisti, Antichristiani saeuiant, oramus te, vt Sanctorum tuorum reliquias, forti tua dextera tueáris[?] ac defendas: vt des eis secundum consilium tuum, auitas possessiones, in quibus illi pietatis suae fructus percipiant, ad gloriam tuam & ipsorū instaurationem, & omnium nostrum consolationem;Amen.
main_text.head: VERSVS XVIII.

p.i: Eritq; domus Iacob velut ignis, & domus Iosephi tanquam flamma: domus autē Esau in stipulam, vt accensi in hos consumant ipsos: neque erit superstes domui Esau, quia Iehouah eloquitur.

main_text.p: Secunda Antypophora.de falsis fratribus, & de domesticis Ecclesiae hostib. hoc loco occurrit. Poterat enim aliquis quaerere quid tandem his euenturum esset? Respon-det[?] Propheta; Sicut se habent stipulae adi-gnem & flammas, ita se habent domestici Ecclesiae hostes,ad Ecclesiam. Atqui nullo negocio flammae stipulas absumunt. Ergo & Ecclesia victrix, facile etiam domesticos suos hostes, superabit.

page.notes: Printed running head and page number read as "COMMENTARIA." and "111"; the page number is partly obscured and may be misread. "tueáris" has an accent-like mark I could not confirm. The catchword "Cæté-" and signature "H ij" are faint and uncertain. "Respon-det" is a guess at a line-end break. Long s has been written as s throughout.
